name: topsoil
title: Topsoil
description: For gardeners and landscapers: the services list is one mown lawn, broad roller-mower stripes in two fresh greens lettered soil-black and finished with a spade-cut edge over a strip of soil, laid on a paving-grey ground under flared capitals.

tokens.--font-display: headings, the business name, prices, customer quotes, and the phone number in the header and the call block (flared capitals, like a nurseryman's sign)
tokens.--font-body: body text, the menu and small labels
tokens.--text-s: small text: the menu, labels, the word before a price, the area line beside a standfirst, table headings, footer
tokens.--text-m: base body size, and the size of service titles and side headings
tokens.--text-l: standfirsts, prices on the lawn, customer quotes and the number in the header
tokens.--text-xl: the number in the call block and the price on a service page
tokens.--leading-tight: line spacing of page titles and the business name
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the business name, small capital labels and side headings
tokens.--color-slab: the pale slab behind the call block, and behind code
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, and the heavy rules above page text and under table headings
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: standfirsts, labels, table headings, footer
tokens.--color-accent: link underlines, the line under the current menu item, the rule beside a quote, list markers and ticks
tokens.--color-joint: thin dividing lines: under the header, above the area line beside a standfirst, between table rows, above the checklist, under the call slab
tokens.--color-lawn-light: the lighter mower stripe of the lawn
tokens.--color-lawn-dark: the darker mower stripe of the lawn
tokens.--color-lawn-edge: the dark green lip along the lawn's cut edge: the turf seen side-on
tokens.--color-grain: the faint grain along the mowing direction that makes the lawn read as grass
tokens.--color-on-lawn: all text and link underlines set on the lawn
tokens.--color-soil: the strip of soil under the lawn's cut edge
tokens.--color-crumb: the crumbs speckling the soil strip
tokens.--color-shade: the shadow along the top of the soil strip, where the spade cut
tokens.--stripe-width: width of one mower stripe (the lawn rounds it so it always ends on a whole stripe)
tokens.--soil-depth: height of the soil strip under the lawn
tokens.--page-width: widest the page may get, lawn included
tokens.--columns: the three columns shared by lawn rows, page headers, page text and the call block on wide screens: title or side heading, text, price
tokens.--measure: widest a column of text may get on narrow screens
tokens.--gutter: space between the text and the edge of the screen; the lawn and the call slab reach out across it
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: between a title and its description, between list items
tokens.--space-2: small gap: above and below the lawn's rows, inside table cells, between menu links on a phone
tokens.--space-3: standard gap: between paragraphs, between menu links on wide screens, inside quotes and code blocks
tokens.--space-4: gap between sections, between columns, and inside the call slab
tokens.--rule: thickness of heavy lines: above page text, under table headings and the current menu item, beside a quote, under the call slab, and the green lip of the lawn's cut edge
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the lawn, the call slab and code (square, as a spade cuts)
tokens.--focus-width: thickness of the keyboard focus ring
tokens.--tap-target: smallest height of anything meant to be tapped: menu links, the number in the header, the links under the lawn
